jobs.title: Product Marketing
jobs.description:
THE ROLE

Product Marketing at Gigs is deeply cross-functional. You’ll collaborate closely with Implementations, Product, Sales, Account Management, Creative, Finance, and Data to ensure our partnerships deliver meaningful value to end users and drive sustained revenue growth. 
You’ll shape how connectivity is positioned, launched, and scaled within our partner ecosystem. Our team operates across the full product lifecycle — from influencing product strategy and launch readiness to driving adoption through always-on growth campaigns. You will deliver growth strategies for and with partners. This is a dynamic role that requires strategic thinking, sharp execution, and excellent communication to create win-win outcomes.

A successful candidate will be highly-motivated and self-directed with expertise in juggling multiple accounts and working in a fast-paced environment. 

Salary range:

 - US: $180,000 - $220,000

(The final offer depends on your background, skills, and how you perform through the process. We're open to considering outlier candidates, which may result in an adjustment to the scope and compensation)


WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Build and implement co-marketing programs that strengthen partner relationships and drive revenue.

 - Plan and launch marketing campaigns in close collaboration with strategic partners.

 - Equip partners with resources, playbooks, training materials, and product updates to drive adoption.

 - Work closely with Creative to build high caliber marketing assets (pitch decks, playbooks, paid media ads, whitepapers, videos, etc.) 

 - Work closely with data teams to define success metrics, implement tracking, and optimize campaigns. 

 - Turn successful experiments into repeatable, high-impact playbooks.

 - Build strong partner relationships to foster collaboration and long-term success.


WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - Proven success launching and scaling consumer-facing products in B2B2C or B2C companies, with a strong grasp of growth levers across acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization.

 - You are a storyteller, pitching ideas and concepts comes naturally to you. You can turn ambiguous ideas into inspiring revenue driving content. 

 - You’ve worked extensively with creative teams and can communicate in marketing briefs.

 - You have excellent verbal and written communication skills.

 - Experience at a highly dynamic, high-growth tech company.

 - Experience using AI tools in your day-to-day work to improve speed, creativity, and decision-making.

Bonus points if

 - You have agency, lifecycle, and content marketing experience

 - Experience in the payments, financial technology industry

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Product Manager
jobs.description:
THE ROLE

An Forward Deployed Product Manager is our customers’ technical partner at Gigs. You will help customers plan, coordinate and successfully launch integrations using the Gigs API.

The role is a unique blend of the technical, strategic and operational. Work can range from partnering with Product on a critical feature blocking a strategic onboarding, to scoping, coordinating, and driving an API implementation over multiple geographies with one of the world’s largest Fintechs.

Implementation sits within Customer Success at Gigs but the role lies at the heart of Gigs’ different functions. You will work closely with Product and Engineering, working together to scope new features and provide on-going feedback. But you will also be heavily involved with Growth: working in tandem with the Business Development team for new implementations and being the main point of contact with our largest customers as they do further development.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Deliver customer implementations. You will act as an owner, treating each API integration as a unique proposition and carefully scoping and delivering the perfect implementation for a specific customer’s use case. You will work step by step with the customer to ensure that they are including the right feature set, API endpoints, and wireframes for success.

 - Key technical contact. You’ll work with our customer’s engineering and product teams as they integrate and continue to develop with Gigs, and advise them on the best implementation path.

 - User flow advisor. You will be the subject matter expert when it comes to the UX/UI the customer builds, and specific endpoints that are required to build out a best in class user experience.

 - Project management. You have experience with and are a super user of Smartsheets, Asana, Linear, or another type of project management tool. You will own a portfolio of complex, critical implementations and projects, and will shape roadmaps, define key milestones, and track progress to ensure successful execution ahead of the deadline.

 - Cross-functional coordination: You will ensure alignment across Business Development, Marketing, Product, and Engineering teams, driving them toward a shared vision. By setting clear goals and building cross-functional roadmaps, you will keep all stakeholders focused, coordinated, and executing efficiently.

 - Product Management. We’re creating a completely new product, so you will need to spot when a new feature could help unlock a use case and be comfortable working with product and engineering to make it a reality.

 - Commercial Strategy: Understand the commercial fundamentals of each implementation and work to ensure they are delivered successfully. Deeply understand what characterises a high conversion user flow and help our customers successfully implement it.

 


WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - You are an implementation powerhouse: You have 5+ years of experience in Implementation, Professional Services, or Product Management at a B2B or SaaS tech company. Your expertise lies in working with high-growth, product-led technology companies, ideally in FinTech or HR. You’ve worked on complex API integrations and you know exactly how to execute them successfully.

 - You have exceptional project management skills: Juggling multiple high-priority projects is second nature to you, thanks to your outstanding organizational skills and ability to maintain clarity in chaotic situations. You are organized and are a champion at pushing customer projects forward.

 - You balance a technical, product, and commercial mindset: You have a strong technical aptitude with the ability to understand and influence product development, and a deep understanding of API’s and webhooks. Additionally, your business acumen shows you have the ability to onboard into complex, operationally intensive industries, and ensures well-rounded decision-making.

 - You are a master of communication: Your written and verbal communication skills are exceptional, allowing you to convey complex ideas effectively and engage with diverse stakeholders. You are able to persuade C-level executives at leading tech-enabled businesses.

 - You are proactive, creative, and hands-on: You take the initiative to tackle challenges, bring creativity to your work, and consistently think ahead in a fast-paced environment. You are not afraid to roll-up your sleeves and execute when needed, and you’re not afraid to think out of the box. You are comfortable creating processes, playbooks, and assets from scratch.

Salary Range: $200,000 - $250,000 
(The final offer depends on your background, skills, and how you perform through the process. We're open to considering outlier candidates, which may result in an adjustment to the scope and compensation)

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager, Connectivity (Americas)
jobs.description:
THE ROLE 

The Technical Product Manager for Connectivity, Americas will take over integrations for our Americas network team and drive the roadmap needed to bring new carriers into the Gigs operating system across the region — helping unlock the next $100–250M in ARR as we expand in the Americas.

Carriers hand us fragmented, often-archaic systems, and your job is to figure out how to use them to unlock our unified user and developer experience, abstracting complexity and making it manageable for our platform and our partners. You'll define which platform features each integration can support, weigh in on whether a carrier meets our technical and product standards, and iterate on existing integrations. You'll do this hands-on with a dedicated Americas engineering team, and in close partnership with our connectivity team.

Success in this role means excelling at product discovery, technical scoping, and prioritization in a deeply technical, operationally intensive domain. Telecom expertise isn't required, but a background in a similarly complex, integration-heavy industry is important.

Salary Range: $210,000 - $240,000


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the Americas network integration roadmap, balancing new-market expansion, reliability, and the long-term platform vision

 - Take the fragmented, often-legacy systems carriers hand us and figure out how to deliver our product experience on top of them

 - Define which platform features each integration can support, mapping provider capabilities onto our platform and scoping the work with your engineering team

 - Determine whether a carrier meets our technical and standards — one input into a carrier-fit decision that also turns on commercial and strategic factors

 - See around corners: identifying and managing risks of integrations early on

 - Partner with Connectivity and Engineering to land integrations on time


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

 - 6+ years of product management experience, ideally in API, platform, or integration-heavy systems

 - Excellent analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills

 - Hands-on mentality: you take ownership and move projects forward while keeping everyone in the loop, over-communicating in a remote environment

 - Able to juggle many competing priorities at once without getting overwhelmed

 - Excellent technical understanding — you've worked on complex integration projects and can hold your own with engineers

 - Fluency with data: familiar with data analytics tools and able to run your own analysis to prioritize and show impact

 - Can quickly get up to speed on telecom or similarly complex domains

 - Based on the US East Coast, or able to work consistently on East Coast hours

 - You enjoy working with cross-functional teams and managing complex projects


NICE TO HAVE

 - Previous exposure to telecommunications, connectivity, or network infrastructure

 - Experience building 0→1 products or working in fast-growing scale-ups

 - Experience working in a remote environment

→ We know that perfect candidates don't exist. Even if not all of this applies to you, we'd love to learn more about you.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Consumer Mobile
jobs.description:
THE ROLE

As Senior Product Manager, Consumer Mobile, you will own our consumer native app product end-to-end. You will be the first PM focused exclusively on what consumers can install on their phones — not the partner-platform layer, but the user-facing mobile surface itself: a consumer app that sets the bar.

If you're excited about owning a consumer mobile product from scratch, sweating the small details of the UX, and shipping something millions of people will use daily — we'd love to meet you.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Work closely with B2B customers and prospects to build leading MVNO apps that convert well, elevate brands, and lead with self-service and automation

 - Own the consumer native app end to end, including operations, support flows, commercial model, user journey, and quality

 - Prototype and partner with design to push the bar on consumer mobile craft — animations, ergonomics and speed

 - Own consumer-facing app metrics: conversion, revenue, session quality, contact rates, NPS, store ratings

 - Drive experimentation and qualitative research; this role lives close to actual end users

 - Work with implementation managers and partner PMs to ensure the app surface scales across implementations


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of product management experience, with demonstrable consumer mobile shipping experience — has shipped iOS/Android apps that real consumers use daily

 - Strong product taste, especially for mobile-native UX patterns

 - Direct experience working with mobile engineering teams — understands the iOS/Android release cycle, app store dynamics, and native vs. cross-platform tradeoffs

 - Customer-first — does user research, watches sessions, reads reviews

 - Comfortable being the first or only senior PM in a domain and defining the operating mechanisms


NICE TO HAVE

 - Shipped at consumer mobile-first companies

 - Telecom, connectivity, or fintech mobile background

 - Has shipped at the 0→1 product stage

 - Familiarity with modern AI tooling in mobile UX (assistants, smart defaults)

 - Native iOS or Android engineering background (former engineer or strong technical comfort)

jobs.title: Group Product Manager
jobs.description:
THE ROLE

As a Group Product Manager at Gigs, you'll lead a team of product managers building the platform that lets any company offer its own mobile service. That covers our APIs, network integrations, and the experiences our customers put in front of their users.

You'll set direction across multiple product areas, stay close to the hardest problems yourself, and raise the bar on product craft across the team. If you're an exceptional product leader, we'd like to meet you now, even if the exact scope is something we shape together.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Lead and coach a team of product managers to deliver consistently against committed KPIs, building clear ownership, strong product craft, and predictable execution.

 - Own strategy and roadmap across multiple product areas, balancing customer value, business impact, and long-term platform foundations

 - Stay hands-on by owning key problems end-to-end, from discovery and specs to build vs. buy decisions and launch

 - Partner with Engineering and Design leadership to turn vision into execution, align priorities, and make trade-offs across teams

 - Work directly with customers, network partners, and internal teams to understand problems, validate solutions, and drive measurable outcomes

 - Shape how the product org works, including where AI and automation change how we discover, build, and ship


WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - 7+ years in product management, including 3+ years leading and coaching other product managers

 - A strong track record shipping in complex domains, ideally platforms, APIs, or backend-heavy systems

 - Sound judgment and the ability to make calls with imperfect information while keeping teams aligned

 - A customer-oriented mindset, with experience working directly with customers, engineers, and cross-functional partners

 - Clear, concise communication (especially written) and an owner mindset that creates momentum

 - Hands-on use of modern AI tools, with a view on where they make product teams better, not just faster


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience in telecom or other operationally intensive industries (payments, marketplaces, neobanks, infrastructure)

 - Experience building 0→1 products or scaling products through rapid growth

 - A strong technical background (former engineer, CS degree or similar)

 - Experience building or growing a product team from an early stage
